paper.title_en: Gravitational Memory from AdS States in the Flat-Space Limit
paper.abstract_en: We study linearized gravitational reconstruction in global AdS$_4$ with dynamical scalar matter, building on vacuum Einstein perturbations with fixed boundary metric and nontrivial normalizable data. External scalar sources prepare an excited state and modify the holographic Ward identities, while subsequent evolution can proceed without boundary driving. Separating the bulk matter-sourced response from vacuum perturbations, we derive an electric quadrupole master equation with the matter-dependent corrections required by the Einstein constraints. We also verify that a cylindrical boundary integral reproduces the Regge--Wheeler master field mode by mode, without identifying it with the full global Fefferman--Graham reconstruction. For weakly interacting scalars that become massless in the flat-space limit, we extract the Bondi shear and news from retarded gravitational evolution. The resulting supertranslation memory agrees numerically with the outgoing energy redistribution and the quadrupole moment of the boundary work. In the ordered flat-space limit, later boundary controls leave the first event's waveform unchanged, despite cancelling residual gravitational modes at finite AdS radius.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究AdS4中全息引力重构与平直空间极限下的引力记忆效应，涉及电四极矩主方程、Regge-Wheeler主变量与Bondi剪切/news推导，理论层次较深，与引力记忆及广义相对论基础议题直接相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 平直空间极限下来自AdS态的引力记忆
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究带有动力学标量物质的整体AdS$_4$中的线性化引力重构，建立在边界度规固定且具有非平凡可归一化数据的真空Einstein扰动之上。外部标量源制备一个激发态并修改全息Ward恒等式，而随后的演化可以在没有边界驱动的情况下进行。将体物质诱导响应与真空扰动分离，我们推导出一个电四极矩主方程，其中包含Einstein约束所要求的依赖于物质的修正。我们还验证了一个柱形边界积分能够逐模地重现Regge--Wheeler主场，但并未将其等同于完整的整体Fefferman--Graham重构。对于在平直空间极限下变为无质量的弱相互作用标量，我们从推迟引力演化中提取Bondi剪切与news。所得的超平移记忆在数值上与出射能量重分布以及边界功的四极矩一致。在有序的平直空间极限中，尽管在有限AdS半径下残余引力模被抵消，较晚的边界控制仍使第一个事件的波形保持不变。
decision.translation_warning: 术语“news”按引力波文献惯例保留英文，未作意译。
